summary_en: This work combines a near-infrared elastin-targeted probe, ElaNIR, with 3D multispectral photoacoustic computed tomography. Spectral unmixing separates probe signals from hemoglobin and enables depth-resolved visualization of skin, ear, and organ-level biodistribution. Young and aged mice show distinct elastin-associated signal patterns, making this a direct molecular and volumetric photoacoustic-imaging contribution suitable for the main library.

summary_en: The paper introduces a 266 nm ultraviolet photoacoustic microscopy platform with approximately 278 nm lateral resolution for label-free imaging of individual nuclei in intact live brain organoids. Z-axis scanning enables depth-resolved subvolume imaging without physical sectioning, while ethanol-treated organoids demonstrate quantitative nuclear-morphology changes. The acquisition system and image-formation method are central contributions, so the paper belongs in the main library.
